paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the comparison of time spent in two categories: "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." There are two slices in total. The slice labeled "Efficient deployment" is colored blue and represents approximately 30.08% of the chart, while the slice labeled "Reduction" is colored orange and accounts for approximately 69.92%. Percentage labels are included inside each slice for clarity. The chart does not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices are ordered by descending size from "Reduction" to "Efficient deployment."
